events.title: The Raffle
events.text: A biscuit tin of folded tickets. 'One each, love. Winner takes the tin. Everybody else takes what they get.'

rows.text: A yellow ticket: a card from the tin.
A blue ticket: a fistful of gold.
The winning ticket. The tin had a relic in it.

check.fail_text: The Clerk's hand closes over yours. It is much stronger than it looks.

events.title: A Quiet Game
events.text: Someone at a side table is throwing dice for money. 'High roll wins. Your stake, my stake. Simple.'

check.pass_text: You win. He pays you in coins that are still warm.
check.fail_text: He wins. He always wins. He apologises.

options.label: Stake a hero's luck instead
options.result: He rolls for you. You win something you can't see, and lose something you can feel.

events.title: The Wishing Well
events.text: A well in the middle of the page. The water is a long way down. Coins glint. Something else glints back.

options.label: Throw in 20 gold
options.result: Warmth comes up out of the well like breath.

check.pass_text: You come up wet and rich.
check.fail_text: Something bit you. You came up with a little anyway.

events.title: A Stranger on the Floor
events.text: An adventurer from somebody else's campaign is lying in the margin. Their miniature is chipped. 'Take me with you,' they say. 'Or take my things.'

options.label: Take them with you
options.result: They stand up, unsteadily, and join the table.

options.label: Take their things
options.result: They watch you do it.

options.label: Patch them up and send them on
options.result: They limp off to their own campaign. Your party feels better about itself.

events.title: The Bargain Bin
events.text: A bin of returned prizes. 'All sold as seen. Some were seen doing things.'

options.label: Dig for a relic (30 gold)
options.result: You find something with the price tag still on.

options.label: Grab a handful of cards (15 gold)
options.result: Two cards. One is sticky.

options.label: Swap a relic for gold
options.result: The Clerk weighs it, sniffs it, pays you.

events.title: The Long Mirror
events.text: A mirror propped against nothing. Your party is in it, but slightly to the left, and one of them is smiling.

check.pass_text: You learn something about yourself you'd rather not have.
check.fail_text: You keep seeing it at the edge of your vision. Next fight, your party starts confused.

options.label: Smash it
options.result: Seven years. And a shard of something useful.

events.title: Somebody's Bones
events.text: A skeleton in a chair, holding a hand of cards. Its turn, by the look of it.

options.label: Play its hand
options.result: Good cards. Cold cards. Your party starts the next fight cursed.

options.label: Bury it
options.result: It seems lighter when you lift it.

events.title: A Campfire
events.text: Someone has drawn a campfire on the page. It gives off real heat. The Caller is pretending not to watch.

options.label: Rest by it
options.result: For a moment it is almost cosy.

options.label: Tell stories
options.result: Everyone remembers something they'd forgotten they knew.

options.label: Sharpen everything
options.result: Next fight, your party starts empowered.

events.title: An Offer
events.text: The Auctioneer leans over the table. 'Off the record. I'll give you something good for something you'll miss.'

options.label: Trade max HP for a rare relic
options.result: Done. You feel slightly thinner.

options.label: Trade all your cards for gold
options.result: He shuffles them into his own deck.

events.title: Scratchcard
events.text: 'Free scratchcard with every visit, love. Match three.' Three silver panels.

rows.text: A bear. Not a match. A small consolation.

options.label: Keep it for later
options.result: It turns out to be a raffle ticket after all.

events.title: The Old Pro
events.text: An old miniature with a lot of paint chipped off. 'I can show one of you a thing or two. For a price.'

options.label: Pay 40 gold for a lesson
options.result: Hard lessons. Good ones.

check.pass_text: He laughs and shows you how to do it properly.
check.fail_text: He laughs and shows you the floor.

events.title: A Lost Die
events.text: A twenty-sided die, lying face down. On the poster at the hall it said: LOST. ONE DIE. ANSWERS TO NOTHING.

options.label: Keep it
options.result: It is warm, and heavier on one side.

options.label: Hand it in at the counter
options.result: The Clerk is visibly moved. Gold changes hands.

rows.text: A one. It rolls away and won't come back.

events.title: The Tea Urn
events.text: The tea urn has been on since before the campaign. The Night Nurse pours four cups without asking.

options.label: Drink up
options.result: Stewed, but it helps.

options.label: Ask for something stronger (20 gold)
options.result: She puts something in the cups. Injuries ease.

options.label: Pocket the biscuits
options.result: They're medicinal. She says.

events.title: The Toll
events.text: A gate across the page and a man with a cash box. 'Toll. Everyone pays. One way or another.'

options.label: Pay 30 gold
options.result: He lets you through and wishes you luck. He seems to mean it.

options.label: Pay in blood
options.result: He takes it with a little silver spoon.

options.label: Go round the long way
options.result: The long way is full of people who also didn't pay.

events.title: The Painter
events.text: Someone is repainting miniatures at a little desk with a tiny brush. 'Hold still. This will improve you.'

options.label: Let them paint a hero
options.result: A fresh coat. They look newer. Sturdier. Not quite themselves.

options.label: Ask them to paint the enemy
options.result: They paint the next lot in very thin colours. Next fight, enemies have 20% less HP.

check.pass_text: You pocket a brush and something else that was in the jar.
check.fail_text: They dab a red dot on you. Next fight, your party is marked.

events.title: Crossroads Shrine
events.text: A little shrine where two pencil lines cross. Offerings: coins, a tooth, a die.

options.label: Leave a coin (10 gold)
options.result: Next fight your party starts blessed.

options.label: Take the offerings
options.result: Gold. And the feeling of being looked at. Next fight your party starts cursed.

check.fail_text: Nothing answers. That is its own sort of answer.

events.title: The Last Party
events.text: Your dead are standing at the edge of the page, translucent, waiting for a turn that isn't coming.

options.label: Speak to them
options.result: They tell you how they died. It is useful, and awful.

options.label: Take their equipment
options.result: They let you. They don't look away. Next fight, your party starts frightened.

options.label: Let them rest
options.result: They nod and are gone. The table feels lighter.

events.title: Sweepstakes
events.text: 'Put a hero's name in the hat. If they survive the next fight, they collect. If not, I do.'

options.label: Put a name in
options.result: The next fight will be an elite. Your champion has been training for it already.

options.label: Bet on the house
options.result: He pays out now. The next lot of enemies are a little sturdier.

events.title: A Torn Page
events.text: A page torn from the rulebook, blowing across the table. The Caller glances at it, then at you.

options.label: Keep it
options.result: Page 41. A paragraph about ties.

options.label: Give it back to him
options.result: He takes it, and strikes one of his own rules out in thanks. Or to make room.

options.label: Eat it
options.result: Dry. Educational.

events.title: Bingo Night
events.text: The campaign stops. The Caller produces a bingo card for each of you. 'Old habits.' He starts calling.

rows.text: Nothing. Two away on one card.
Full house. He seems genuinely pleased for you.

check.pass_text: Full house. He knows. He lets it go. This time.
check.fail_text: He knows. He adds a rule.

options.label: Get on with the campaign
options.result: He looks a little disappointed. You use the break to rest.

events.title: Highwaymen
events.text: Painted cut-out bandits pop up from behind the scenery. 'Your money or your lives!' They are made of cardboard and quite determined.

options.label: Fight
options.result: They come at you. They have some gold, at least.

options.label: Pay them off (25 gold)
options.result: They take it and fold flat.

check.pass_text: One of them throws in with you. Not cardboard, it turns out.

events.title: The Fortune-Teller
events.text: A veiled figure turns over cards. 'I see a death. I see a prize. Choose which one you want me to look at.'

options.label: Look at the death
options.result: Forewarned. Next fight your party starts warded.

options.label: Look at the prize
options.result: A prize, and the road to it. The next fight is an elite.

check.pass_text: You draw Sudden Death. You'll learn quickly.
check.fail_text: You draw the Glass Table. Everyone hits harder, you included.

events.title: The Hungry Box
events.text: A wooden box with a slot. A label: FEED ME A CARD. It is purring.

options.label: Feed it a card
options.result: It purrs louder and spits out a relic.

options.label: Feed it gold (30)
options.result: It coughs up three cards. Slightly damp.

options.label: Kick it
options.result: It bites. Some coins fall out.

events.title: Insert Coin
events.text: An arcade cabinet in the corner of the page. CONTINUE? it asks. A coin slot.

options.label: Insert 50 gold
options.result: One more go. The cabinet dispenses a pewter halo.

events.title: Your Own Miniatures
events.text: Four miniatures, painted exactly like your party, standing in the middle of the page. One is facing the wrong way.

options.label: Turn it round
options.result: Something in one of your heroes clicks into place.

options.label: Smash them
options.result: It hurts. It helps. Next fight your party starts empowered.

options.label: Take them
options.result: They weigh more than they should.

events.title: Lost Property
events.text: A cardboard box: LOST PROPERTY. Inside: a hat, a lot of single gloves, and something wrapped in newspaper.

options.label: Unwrap the newspaper
options.result: Whatever it was, it's yours now.

options.label: Take the gloves
options.result: There were things in the gloves.

options.label: Hand in something of yours
options.result: The Receptionist gives you a ticket and a sandwich.

events.title: The Weeping Statue
events.text: A statue of somebody's hero. Its eyes are wet. A plaque: HE STAYED.

options.label: Wipe its eyes
options.result: Next fight your party regenerates for two turns.

check.pass_text: It tells you how he stayed. It takes nerve.
check.fail_text: It tells you why. Next fight, your party starts frightened.

options.label: Topple it
options.result: There was gold in the base. Of course there was.

events.title: The Peddler
events.text: A peddler with a cart that wasn't here a moment ago. 'One-time offer. Pick one. Everything else goes back in the cart.'

options.label: The bottle (20 gold)
options.result: Two healing draughts.

options.label: The box (45 gold)
options.result: A relic, wrapped in brown paper.

options.label: The map (25 gold)
options.result: It shows you what's hidden in this Book.

events.title: An Accident
events.text: The Caller knocks the table. Your miniatures fall over. 'Sorry. Sorry. Let me put them back.' He puts them back. Not quite where they were.

rows.text: He puts one back a level higher. A mistake. He doesn't correct it.
He puts one back with a chip missing.

check.pass_text: Exactly where they were. He seems almost relieved.

events.title: A Challenge
events.text: A painted knight blocks the path. 'Single combat. Your best against me. To first blood.'

check.pass_text: First blood is his. He bows and pays.
check.fail_text: First blood is yours. In the bad way.

check.pass_text: You win without being touched. He gives you his token.
check.fail_text: He has seen that trick before.

events.title: A Supply Cache
events.text: A crate stamped PROPERTY OF THE PREVIOUS PARTY. The previous party will not be needing it.

options.label: Take the medicine
options.result: A draught and some salts.

options.label: Take the weapons
options.result: Lamp oil and weapon oil.

options.label: Take the money
options.result: Forty gold and a note saying sorry.

events.title: Intermission
events.text: 'Five minutes,' says the Caller, and leaves the table. The hall is very quiet without him. You could do anything.

check.pass_text: You read ahead. You cross something out.
check.fail_text: He comes back early. He adds a rule. He doesn't say why.

options.label: Stretch your legs
options.result: Everyone feels better for walking about.

options.label: Sit perfectly still
options.result: When he comes back he looks at you for a long time. He seems pleased.

events.title: A List of Names
events.text: A sign-in sheet pinned to the page. Your names are already on it, in a hand that isn't yours.

options.label: Cross your names out
options.result: The pen bites. A rule is struck out too.

options.label: Sign again, properly
options.result: It feels like confirming a booking.

options.label: Add a name
options.result: Somebody sits down at the table who wasn't there before.

events.title: The Drinks Cart
events.text: A trolley squeaks up to your elbow. Bottles, a bucket of ice, something in a jar with a face. 'On the house,' he says. Nothing is on the house.

options.label: Something strong
options.result: Two shots, poured where he can see. He watches you pocket them. He doesn't stop you.

options.label: The jar with the face
options.result: It bites on the way out. You keep the head anyway.

options.label: Just water
options.result: Water. He seems disappointed in you. Good.

events.title: Another Table
events.text: Across the hall, another table is set up. Another party, mid-game. They don't look up. Their miniatures look like yours.

check.pass_text: Two pieces off their stash. Nobody notices. Nobody at that table is breathing.
check.fail_text: One of them grabs your wrist. Their hand is cold and painted.

options.label: Watch their game
options.result: They cheat, badly. You learn how not to.

events.title: Dice on the Floor
events.text: Under the table, a scatter of dice. Some of them are his. Some of them are warm.

options.label: Pocket them
options.result: Into your sleeve. He hears them click.

options.label: Give them back
options.result: 'Honest,' he says, like it's a disease. He tips you anyway.

options.label: Crush one underfoot
options.result: It cracks like a tooth. There was something inside it.

events.title: The Caller's Dentist
events.text: A chair with straps. A tray of tools. 'He has a lot of teeth to keep clean,' she says, 'and some of them are yours now. Sit.'

options.label: Sit (30 gold)
options.result: She takes something out and puts something in. It's better. It's worse.

options.label: Buy a tooth (20 gold)
options.result: She threads it on a string for you. It's still warm.
